name: SessionPill
need: A live session that outlasts the current screen (an active call, a running recording) needs one floating affordance that follows the user everywhere and offers the one action that matters. Built twice: one app's live-call pill (timer + return-to-call) and another app' recording pill (pulse dot + stop). Two apps, same shape — the promotion trigger fired.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: A toast announces and leaves; a session pill stays exactly as long as the session does and is the way BACK into it.
A banner occupies layout at the top of a page; the pill floats over every page because the session belongs to the app, not to a screen.

proposedApi.SessionPill: label, timer?, actionLabel?, icon?, onClick, onDismiss? + dismissLabel, tone? (danger pulse by default, warning static) — the app shell renders it once while a session is live; clicking returns to the session

sources: apps/one app live-call pill (timer, return to call), apps/another app recording pill (pulse dot, stop)
decision: Promote as a molecule. Another app adopted it 2026-08-20 (RecordingPill keeps the wiring, renders SessionPill). One app deliberately does NOT adopt it for the live-call pill: that is an emergency affordance a review made solid-red and top-centre because the white card version blended into the chrome, and an active call may not be dismissed. Recorded in the scout's ACCEPTED_PARALLEL (LiveCallBar); a second app needing a critical pill is the trigger for a variant here.
